summary: Native StatusModifier MultiplyForKingdom<id> on Damage@FromTarget (English: 'If the Enemy is from <Kingdom> or if the battle is in <Kingdom>, deal double damage') tests the damaged target's kingdom. The only condition available, kingdomOf {side:'enemy'}, is true when ANY living enemy belongs to the kingdom, so a non-target enemy from the kingdom doubles the hit. Needs a target-scoped condition (targetKingdom, symmetric to targetRace / targetColor; kingdom of the segment's target, or of the chosen target) so the curated condMult can become anyOf(targetKingdom, kingdomPresent). The 33 kingdom weapons (batch-w02) and 1429/1479/1499/1560 then switch; troop:7665 (L7) uses the same pattern. Side note for whoever regenerates these: the zh desc of all 34 kingdom weapons has a stray 'l' ('造成l [魔法 + 5]') in pool-w01.json / batch-w02 / weapons.json; a zh fix needs gowWeaponReviewedOverrides entries (description + prototype) per gowWeaponRegenerationGuard.
repro: castSpell({key:'weapon:1318', target:11, enemies:[{hp:600,armor:5,kingdom:'阿达纳'},{hp:900,armor:10},{hp:300,armor:12},{hp:800,armor:3}]}) -> E11 (not from Adana) takes double damage because E10 is from Adana; native: single damage.

note: secondary.ts condition targetKingdom (target-relative); 37 kingdom weapons anyOf(targetKingdom, kingdomPresent), troop:7665 9593 targetKingdom; zh 造成l fixed with override entries; 37 weapons accepted L4a; golden diff 0

summary: Blightwing 8276 native: ExplodeColor@FromTarget Red [AddForBurning 3] -> ExplodeColor@FromTarget Green [AddForDisease 3] -> Damage@FromTarget 1+M. The explosions (and their skull cascades) resolve before the damage and read the chosen enemy's status. No condition reads the chosen target's status before a targeting segment runs (lastTargetStatus / lastTargetStatusAtCastStart need castTracking.lastTarget; targetStatus needs a segment target). Needs chosenTargetStatus {statusId} (chosen target id, like chosenTargetColor/chosenTargetRace; read the status at cast start or live) so the curated order can become explodeRed(ifCond burning), explodeGreen(ifCond disease), dmg.
repro: castSpell({key:'troop:6857', enemies:[{},{statuses:[{id:'burning',turns:99},{id:'disease',turns:99}]},{},{}]}) -> order dmg E11 11, explode (Green), explode (Red); native: explode Red, explode Green, then dmg.

summary: Native ExplodeColor Skull <N> (random N Skulls; 8504 'Explode 3 Skulls', also spell 7136 'explode 10 Skulls') is built with explodeRandomSkulls -> randomGems include 'skull', which only picks plain skullGem (gems.ts: include 'skull' && kind !== 'skull' -> skip). R013-5 says Skull variants (Doom Skull, Uber Doom Skull) are Skulls and colour-Skull clears (RemoveColor/DestroyColor Skull, gems.ts ~600) already include them. The random-N Skull pool should include the Skull variants too (matchJoinKey 'skull'), consistently with R013-5.
repro: castSpell({key:'troop:7001', board: all Doom Skulls except 1 plain Skull}) -> explodes only around the plain Skull; native: any 3 Skull-coloured gems incl. Doom Skulls.
